{{DISPLAYTITLE:Zombie (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:Zombie - Status.gif|right]]
[[File:FFTA-spr-zombie.gif|left]]
{{Quote|Dark magic animates these walking corpses.|Description}}
'''Zombies''' are [[undead]] enemies in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''. As such, they are weak to [[Fire (element)|Fire]] and [[Cure (ability)|Cure]] spells, and will revive themselves three turns after being [[Knocked Out]]. They are less dangerous than the other undead enemy, the [[Vampire (Tactics Advance)|Vampire]], having no teleportation abilities and less-than-spectacular [[HP (stat)|HP]] and movement stats. As they are in permanent Zombie status, burying skills will remove them from battle.

{{See|Zombie (enemy)}}
